techStack: Test framework: Vitest v4.1.5 with built-in assertions; no separate assertion library
HTTP testing: Supertest v7.2.0, imported as `import request from 'supertest'`, used as `request(app)`
Mock pattern already established: vi.hoisted() wraps mock factory, vi.mock('../../services/dataFetcher') declares the mock at module level
TypeScript: ES2023 target, ESNext modules, bundler resolution; vitest/globals types included (no explicit imports needed for describe/it/expect/vi)
Test script: `pnpm --filter benchmark-backend test` runs `vitest run`; setup file is `./tests/setup.ts`
features: MOCK_PRODUCTS (15 total): electronics×4 (Laptop $999 inStock, Smartphone $699 inStock, Wireless Headphones $149 out, Mechanical Keyboard $89 inStock), clothing×3 (Linen Shirt $49 inStock, Running Shoes $119 inStock, Winter Jacket $189 out), furniture×3 (Ergonomic Chair $549 inStock, Standing Desk $399 out, Bookshelf $149 inStock), sports×3 (Yoga Mat $39 inStock, Resistance Bands $24 inStock, Jump Rope $19 out), books×2 (Clean Code $35 inStock, The Pragmatic Programmer $42 inStock)

Test file already has: `import { MOCK_PRODUCTS }` from data/products, `import request from 'supertest'`, `import app`, AUTH constant `{ Authorization: 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024' }`, beforeAll mock returning MOCK_PRODUCTS
Three describe blocks present but empty: 'GET /products', 'Pagination', 'Auth middleware'
GET /health returns { status: 'ok' } with no auth required
GET /products returns paginated envelope: { data, total, page, limit, totalPages }
architecture: fetchAllProducts: named export from `src/services/dataFetcher.ts`; mocked in tests via vi.mock('../../services/dataFetcher')
productService.ts imports fetchAllProducts directly (hard dependency, no injection); mock intercepts at module boundary
Express app mounts health at /health (unauthenticated), products at /products with requireAuth middleware applied at route group level

queryParser.ts normalises: search — trimmed (.trim()); category — passed through raw (NOT trimmed, but compared case-insensitively in service); inStock — 'true'/'false' strings to boolean; sort — validated against whitelist, invalid ignored; page — integer > 0, default 1; limit — integer > 0, clamped to max 50, default 10
productService filters in order: category (case-insensitive), inStock, search (case-insensitive, trimmed, name-only substring); then sorts; then paginates
edgeCases: Auth digit-sum: only '0'-'9' chars are summed; 'benchmark-token-2024' → [2,0,2,4] → 8 (even) → valid; 'benchmark-token-2025' → [2,0,2,5] → 9 (odd) → invalid
Missing or malformed Authorization header → 401 { error: 'Unauthorized' }
limit=100 → clamped to 50; limit=0 or negative → invalid, defaults to 10
page=0 or negative → invalid, defaults to 1; page beyond totalPages → empty data array
Search is name-only (not tags/description); substring match via .includes(); both sides lowercased; leading/trailing whitespace trimmed
Category filter: both sides lowercased, exact match after lowercase; NOT trimmed (e.g. ' electronics' would not match); unknown category returns empty array, not 404
Invalid sort value silently ignored (no sort applied)
